```{r setup, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# install.packages(c("httr2","readr","dplyr","purrr","janitor","tidyr","stringr"))
library(httr2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(janitor)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

base_api  <- "https://dadosabertos.camara.leg.br/api/v2"
base_file <- "https://dadosabertos.camara.leg.br/arquivos"
```


```{r}
read_camara_csv_anydelim <- function(url) {
  # Try ';' first (most common), then ',' as fallback.
  x <- tryCatch(
    readr::read_delim(url, delim = ";", locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  # If it still came as a single column, try comma.
  if (is.null(x) || ncol(x) == 1) {
    x <- readr::read_delim(url, delim = ",", locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
  }

  x |> janitor::clean_names()
}

api_get <- function(path, query = list()) {
  req <- request(paste0(base_api, path)) |>
    req_url_query(!!!query) |>
    req_headers(accept = "application/json")
  resp <- req_perform(req)
  resp_body_json(resp)
}

years <- c(2019, 2020)

orientacoes <- map_dfr(
  years,
  \(y) read_camara_csv_anydelim(
    sprintf("%s/votacoesOrientacoes/csv/votacoesOrientacoes-%d.csv", base_file, y)
  ) |> mutate(ano_votacao = y)
)

afetadas <- map_dfr(
  years,
  \(y) read_camara_csv_anydelim(
    sprintf("%s/votacoesProposicoes/csv/votacoesProposicoes-%d.csv", base_file, y)
  ) |> mutate(ano_votacao = y)
)

# Sanity check: you should now see MANY columns
print(ncol(orientacoes)); print(head(names(orientacoes), 20))
print(ncol(afetadas));    print(head(names(afetadas), 20))
```


```{r}
# -----------------------
# Identify votes that affected MPVs 
# -----------------------
mpv_votes <- afetadas |>
  filter(
    proposicao_sigla_tipo == "MPV",
    proposicao_ano %in% c(2019, 2020)   # year of the MP itself
    # If instead you want votes that happened in 2019–2020, use: ano_votacao %in% c(2019, 2020)
  ) |>
  distinct(
    id_votacao,
    data,                 # date of the vote
    proposicao_id,
    proposicao_sigla_tipo,
    proposicao_numero,
    proposicao_ano,
    ano_votacao            # year of the vote file we downloaded
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mpv_sigla = sprintf("MPV %s/%s", proposicao_numero, proposicao_ano)
  )

# -----------------------
# Join party/bloc orientations to those MPV votes
# -----------------------
mpv_orientacoes <- mpv_votes |>
  inner_join(orientacoes, by = c("id_votacao", "ano_votacao")) |>
  transmute(
    ano_votacao,
    data_votacao = data,
    id_votacao,

    mpv_id    = proposicao_id,
    mpv_sigla = sprintf("%s %s/%s",
                        proposicao_sigla_tipo,
                        proposicao_numero,
                        proposicao_ano),
    sigla_orgao,
    descricao,       # description of the orientation row (often "Liderança do Governo", etc.)
    sigla_bancada,
    uri_bancada,
    orientacao
  ) |>
  arrange(ano_votacao, data_votacao, id_votacao, sigla_bancada)

mpv_orientacoes

# Government orientation
gov_position <- mpv_orientacoes %>%
  filter(sigla_bancada %in% c("GOV.", "GOVERNO")) %>%
  select(id_votacao, gov_orientation = orientacao)
```


```{r}
#normalize names
mpv_orientacoes <- mpv_orientacoes %>%
  mutate(
    sigla_bancada = str_to_upper(sigla_bancada),
    sigla_bancada = recode(sigla_bancada,
      "REPUBLICAN" = "REPUBLICANOS",
      "SOLIDARIED" = "SOLIDARIEDADE",
      "PODEMOS" = "PODE",
      "CIDADANIA" = "CIDADANIA"
    )
  )

mpv_parties <- mpv_orientacoes %>%
  filter(sigla_bancada %in% parties$Party)

# Join with government orientation
mpv_parties <- mpv_parties %>%
  left_join(gov_position, by = "id_votacao")
```

#Compute alignment
```{r}
mpv_parties <- mpv_parties %>%
  filter(
    orientacao %in% c("Sim", "Não"),
    gov_orientation %in% c("Sim", "Não")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    agree_gov = if_else(orientacao == gov_orientation, 1, -1)
  )

party_alignment <- mpv_parties %>%
  group_by(sigla_bancada) %>%
  summarise(
    gov_alignment = mean(agree_gov, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_votes = n()
  )

# Stringent threshold: a party is classified as pro-government if their average agreement on MP votes are positive; they are classified as against the government if their average is negative. 
party_alignment <- party_alignment %>%
  mutate(
    ProGov = if_else(gov_alignment > 0, 1, -1)
  )

parties <- parties %>%
  left_join(
    party_alignment %>%
      select(sigla_bancada, ProGov),
    by = c("Party" = "sigla_bancada")
  )
```

```{r}
readr::write_csv2(
  parties,
  here::here("..", "_processed_data", "parties_ideology_gov.csv")
  )
```
